<repaired_code>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &x, &y, &n);
    
    double target = (double)x / y;
    int best_a = 0, best_b = 1;
    double min_diff = 1e18;
    
    for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        // Find the best a for this denominator b
        double a_double = target * b;
        int a1 = (int)floor(a_double);
        int a2 = (int)ceil(a_double);
        
        // Check both floor and ceil values
        for (int a : {a1, a2}) {
            if (a < 0) continue; // a must be non-negative
            
            double diff = fabs((double)a / b - target);
            
            // Update if this is better, or same diff but smaller b, or same diff and b but smaller a
            if (diff < min_diff - 1e-12 || 
                (fabs(diff - min_diff) < 1e-12 && b < best_b) ||
                (fabs(diff - min_diff) < 1e-12 && b == best_b && a < best_a)) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best_a = a;
                best_b = b;
            }
        }
    }
    
    printf("%d/%d\n", best_a, best_b);
    return 0;
}
</repaired_code>
